title: Carrier, multiplicity and orientation of the difference of two integer multiplicity triples
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), R₂.orient x = R₁.orient x ∨ R₂.orient x = -R₁.orient x) → ∃ (C : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℕ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet C ∧ C ⊆ R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier ∧ Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ C, 0 < θ x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ C, θ x ≤ R₁.carrier.indicator R₁.mult x + R₂.carrier.indicator R₂.mult x) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ (μHE[n].restrict C) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (C ∩ R₁.carrier)), ξ x = R₁.orient x ∨ ξ x = -R₁.orient x) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (C \ R₁.carrier)), ξ x = R₂.orient x ∨ ξ x = -R₂.orient x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], C.indicator (fun y => (θ y : ℝ) • ξ y) x = R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x - R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
